[[File:Tarred ground.jpg|thumb|Tarred ground]]
'''Tarred ground''' is a detrimental [[ground effect]] that applies the Tarred Ground [[debuff]] (or colloquially known as '''Tar''' debuff). Tarred ground stacks with [[chill]]ing the monster via [[cold damage]]. It does not affect the speed the monsters perform actions at, only their [[movement speed]].<ref name="TarredGround"/>

==Sources==
* Certain [[zombie]]s, as well as [[Brine Vassal]], which spread tar when destroyed
* Projectiles fired by [[Noisome Ophidian]]
* [[Heist]] monster (in [[Contract:_Prohibited_Library|Prohibited Library]] tileset for example) use skills that spread tarred grounds
